bio: Catherine Blydenburgh was a daughter of Joseph Blydenburgh 2d, himself a son of the first Joseph Blydenburgh by his second wife, and a sister of Joseph Blydenburgh (1732–1833). She was not a descendant of Bull Smith.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 485-486 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
researchNotes: Daughter of Joseph Blydenburgh 2d (son of the second wife of Joseph 1st), sister of Joseph Blydenburgh (1732-1833) ([R4-S1]). Not a Bull Smith descendant.
summary: Daughter of Joseph Blydenburgh 2d and sister of Joseph Blydenburgh (1732–1833); not a descendant of Bull Smith.
